text:
joel_sales: Passing to CS - new pilot with FinEdge just closed. Key asks: embeddings-heavy for recommendations (~2.5M tokens/mo), SSO via Okta, wants Private VPC by 45 days, firm renewal conversation planned at 90 days. Customer requires KMS + audit logs. Contract snippet in drive: https://drive.internal/finedge/contract.pdf. Who owns rollout?

maria_cs: I'll own onboarding. Can we do kickoff Tues 10am PT? Need QPS, p99 SLO, and sample prompt set.

ops-bot: Created ticket CS-8123 and support ticket ENG-4002. Reminder set for kickoff Tuesday 10:00 PT.

tess_support: FYI: Private deploy requires SRE runbook and support addendum. I'll start a checklist for infra handoff. We need customer's infra diagram and contact for network/VPN.

vikram_eng: For perf planning: if p99 target is <=200ms and sustained 50 qps, recommend 2xA10-equivalent with autoscale burst. Need typical sequence lengths and embedding dims. If they use long-context retrieval we should plan KV cache + shard pinning.

joel_sales: Customer told me p99 ~180ms for <512 tokens, bursts to 120 qps for short windows, embedding dim 1536, avg seq ~300 tokens. Will upload sample traces + Okta metadata tonight.

renee_cs_manager: Tagging as RENEWAL_RISK given timeline. If onboarding slips beyond 6 weeks, propose 10% credit on first month of Dedicated usage to keep momentum. Maria, mark risk and loop RevOps for approval.

maria_cs: Marked CS-8123 as RISK and added RevOps request. Tess, can support cover monitoring for the trial credit period?

tess_support: We can monitor for a 14-day trial with current SRE capacity if telemetry is shared (metrics + traces). We'll need admin read-only on their monitoring endpoint.

vikram_eng: Once sample prompts are in, I'll run a perf sweep in staging and post results to ENG-4002. If mem > 12GB per replica we may recommend quantization and a batching window tweak.

joel_sales: Uploaded Okta metadata + prompts to drive. Invited FinEdge engineers to kickoff.

maria_cs: Added owners to ticket: maria_cs (lead), tess_support (support), vikram_eng (runtime), joel_sales (sales contact). Next steps: 1) customer sends SSO + KMS key ARN, 2) SRE creates staging private pool (2 GPUs) for smoke, 3) perf sweep and smoke tests, 4) enablement session w/ FinEdge devs. Target go-live window: 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-14.

ops-bot: CS-8123 linked to ENG-4002. Kickoff scheduled.

renee_cs_manager: Thanks team. Keep me posted on perf results; if p99 >250ms we escalate for prioritization.

maria_cs: Will update after kickoff. Closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
